item.text:
Dashboard project links now use `prefetch={false}`. The project page renders the cached title separately, while project details load behind their own Suspense fallback, so the title can appear before the details finish loading.

I didn’t run tests. `package.json` and `package-lock.json` already had workspace changes when I started; I left them untouched.
